data.name: Description
data.value: Update the customer profile, then the linked account flags. Changes across services are not atomic.

data.name: SharedEmail
data.value: Email is also the linked account username. Company and address relations are unchanged.

data.name: ProtectedSettings
data.value: Two-factor authentication and lockout end are read-only and preserved by the server.

data.name: ReloadRequired
data.value: Reload explicitly before another save. No write is automatically retried.

data.name: Saved
data.value: Customer profile and account flags were saved. Reload before making another change.

data.name: PartialCompletion
data.value: The customer profile was saved, but the account update did not complete. Reload to inspect current data; do not repeat the save.

data.name: UnknownOutcome
data.value: The save outcome could not be confirmed. Reload to inspect current data before any further action.

data.name: Stale
data.value: Customer or account data changed. Reload before saving again.

data.name: NavigationChanged
data.value: The selected customer changed during a save. Reload this customer before continuing.

data.name: SessionUnavailable
data.value: The current session could not be verified. No save was sent.

data.name: Forbidden
data.value: You do not have permission to edit this customer and account.

data.name: InvalidResponse
data.value: The server returned incomplete or invalid customer/account data.

data.name: RateLimited
data.value: Too many requests. Wait before reloading.

data.name: InvalidLength
data.value: This value exceeds the allowed length.

data.name: ValidationFailed
data.value: Check the highlighted fields before saving.

data.name: InvalidUsername
data.value: Email must use only ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore, @, plus or hyphen.
